description: This is a shell script used for testing the integration of git and svn with globbing refspecs, including setup of svn repositories, branch and tag creation, and verification of refspec globbing behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail, capturing stderr for comparison.
